description: Canonical component-kind registry. All agent implementations MUST use these identifiers.

workload.notes: Workload requirements drive all downstream choices.

deployment_mode.notes: Mode activates API vs self-hosted branches.

model_provider.notes: Model publisher or API serving provider, not necessarily host.

model.notes: A base generative or auxiliary model.

accelerator.notes: Compute device capabilities, not an instance reservation.

inference_engine.notes: Local or customer-managed model serving runtime.

storage.notes: Storage can back knowledge, vector DB, agent memory, and model artifacts.

data_source.notes: Source metadata; raw document content is not part of catalog.

knowledge_base.notes: Logical curated corpus; sources may span connectors.

embedding_model.notes: Produces vectors for retrieval and long-term memory.

vector_database.notes: A vector index is configured per selection with a fixed dimension.

rag_pipeline.notes: Pipeline binds base model, knowledge, embedding, and retrieval storage.

tool.notes: Callable capability; mutating actions require policy review.

mcp_server.notes: MCP tool provider, subject to authorization and transport compatibility.

memory_store.notes: Memory store shares storage or vector infrastructure across tiers.

integration.notes: External integrations can be callable via tools.

training_compute.notes: Training hardware provision reuses available compute profiles.

fine_tuned_model.notes: Derived model requires a traceable base, dataset, and training path.

guardrail.notes: Safety and compliance controls at explicit enforcement points.

evaluation_suite.notes: A suite defines evaluation gates, not measured results.

deployment_target.notes: The deployment artifact and runtime target.

cost_policy.notes: Budget controls applied to pricebook estimates.
